The Sprite Locker · a free fan-made tracker, not affiliated with Epic Games. Your progress is private and saved only in your own browser — every person who opens this gets their own tracker.
Moving devices? Use 🔑 Backup to copy your progress code. Sprite data is community-sourced (Chapter 7 Season 3) and may need spot-checking.

🖼 Sprite images

The fortnite.gg artwork is already wired in — the app loads each sprite's .webp straight from the folder this file lives in. Keep The Sprite Locker.html in the same folder as your images and everything shows automatically. Anything missing falls back to a themed placeholder.

Folder setting: (same folder) · fallback extension: webp
